subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind `/name` or an explicit named-new syntax?
rationale: The implementation reuses the existing `label` contract, but it intentionally changes user-facing command grammar that overlaps current `/new [model]` expectations and adjacent session-naming work.

options.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
options.body: Land the Control UI-specific shortcut semantics with docs that point model changes to `/model`.

options.title: Require explicit syntax
options.body: Ask the branch to preserve bare `/new` expectations by using `/name`, `/label`, or `/new --name` for naming.

options.title: Defer to broader command work
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers resolve named-new semantics in the broader chat command contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
recommendation.body: Land the Control UI-specific shortcut semantics with docs that point model changes to `/model`.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the accepted `/name` command direction and were explicitly asked to review this PR's command/session UX choice.
